edition.title: Warrior Women
edition.perspective: Centers Madonna Thunder Hawk and her daughter Marcella (Marcy) Gilbert, including their experiences of the American Indian Movement and Native alternative education. The distributor identifies Thunder Hawk as Oohenumpa Lakota and Gilbert as Lakota and Dakota.
edition.scope: The complete 64-minute educational edition and the 57-minute broadcast catalogue duration are separate. No consumer edition duration is independently verified.
edition.captions: GOOD DOCS lists English and captions. No caption file, timing, accuracy or accessibility review was performed.
edition.authorized_distribution: Vision Maker Media links GOOD DOCS as the educational DVD and streaming distributor for this title.
edition.access: GOOD DOCS offers paid educational and institutional licenses, including 14-day hosted streaming with different internal-use, public-screening and fundraiser terms. This product page is not a ready-to-watch free consumer edition.
edition.geographic_scope: Consumer geographic eligibility is unverified. A search snapshot described worldwide Vimeo access, but the actual opened Vimeo page exposed only the title shell; the snapshot is not treated as current access verification.
edition.rights_scope: No license is purchased, no payment or contact form is submitted, and no permission to host, embed or publicly screen the film is inferred.
